name: Artificial Affection
source:
A heterosexual man who avoids women due to deep-seated discomfort.

“In order to solve the declining birthrate, let’s help men like him overcome their fear of women.”

That reckless idea gave birth to the latest android model—Alice.

The protagonist, a newly assigned staff member, is given his first mission:
to test her functions—specifically, a “contact test.”

No matter how cute she looks, she's just a machine. There's no way this plan will work.
—Or so he thought at first.

But as they grow closer, something begins to stir in his heart.
“This can’t be happening. She’s just an android.”

A man who simply wants to live a quiet, “normal” life.
An innocent, cheerful android girl.

Where will their unlikely love story lead...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3686740/]Steam[/url]]
